subject: Acme renewal — keepalive concession approval needed
messages:
From: Nathan Briggs <nathan.briggs@acmeanalytics.com>

Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal — pricing and SLA concerns

Kim / Laura —

Thanks for the heads up on the renewal. We ran the numbers this week and the renewal terms you sent (list price + modest increase) push us well over the FY28 budget the procurement committee allocated for platform costs. We value the platform and the team, but given macro pressures we need three concessions to keep this in the range we can sign without a competing RFP:

- 25% net discount on year 1 (we can discuss step-downs after)
- One-time SLA credit eligible for outages > 4 hours, up to 60 days service credit
- Term reset to align the contract to our fiscal year (start 2027-07-01) and a 12-month renewal with an opt-out after 9 months for cause

If we can't get close to those items by Friday we'd have to pause renewal decisions and look at alternatives. Happy to join a call this afternoon if that helps.

Nathan
Nathan Briggs
SVP, Finance — Acme Analytics

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Recommended keepalive package for Acme (DO NOT SHARE)

Team — recap from the 1pm with Nathan & procurement: Acme is price sensitive and worried about FY alignment. They are a high-value account (current ARR $1.2M, 38% YoY growth in queries). My recommended package to propose: 

- Commercial: 25% discount on year 1 (net), conditioned on a 24-month committed term or 12-month with prepayment at 95% of ARR.
- Credits: One-time usage credit of $30k to offset their Q2 overrun.
- SLA concession: Enhanced SLA credit eligibility up to 45 days for qualifying incidents (tied to our incident classification).
- Term alignment: Offer an addendum to shift start date to 2027-07-01 with pro-rated first period.

Notes/risks: 25% is outside standard deal desk authority (we typically max at 20% for renewals). SLA exposure beyond 30 days requires exec signoff. If we want to close quickly, trade the full 25% for a 24-month term + 50% prepayment option. Attached is a draft offer doc for legal/disc review.

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Offer_v2.pdf

Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Recommended keepalive package for Acme (DO NOT SHARE)

Kim/Laura —

I reviewed LA's recommendation. I'm willing to approve the following as an exception to close the renewal quickly: 

- 25% discount on year 1 (one-time concession)
- SLA credit eligibility up to 60 days for qualifying incidents (caps tied to incident severity; legal to scope)
- $30k one-time usage credit

Conditions: 
1) Deal must convert to a 24-month committed term OR 12-month with 95% upfront prepayment.
2) Include a one-way termination-for-convenience clause only after 12 months with 90-day notice and prepayment terms that mitigate churn risk.
3) Offer expires EOD Friday (2027-04-23).

Markus — I flagged you because the SLA and the 25% hit are above normal tolerance; want to confirm you’re OK to route this to Finance for accounting treatment and Legal for an expedited review.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Final keepalive offer — Acme Analytics (expires 2027-04-23 EOD)

Nathan — thanks again for the call. Per our internal approvals, please find the final keepalive offer below (valid through EOD Friday 2027-04-23):

1) Commercial: 25% discount on year 1 list pricing, conditioned on a 24-month committed term OR 12-month term with 95% prepayment.
2) One-time usage credit: $30,000 applied to first invoice after renewal.
3) SLA concession: Enhanced credit eligibility up to 60 days for qualifying incidents (language to be defined by Legal).
4) Term alignment: We will pro-rate the initial period to start 2027-07-01 as requested.

Next steps: Attached is the finalized offer PDF and a DocuSign transaction is ready here: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC-8675309. If you can route to Legal/Procurement for signature today we will prioritize execution.

Attachment: Acme_Renewal_Final_Offer.pdf
